mapper.select: SELECT EMAIL , NAME , NICKNAME , PASSWORD , TO_CHAR(REGIST_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS REGIST_DATE , TO_CHAR(MODIFY_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS MODIFY_DATE , TO_CHAR(LATEST_LOGIN_SUCCESS_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS LATEST_LOGIN_SUCCESS_DATE , TO_CHAR(LATEST_LOGIN_FAIL_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS LATEST_LOGIN_FAIL_DATE , TO_CHAR(LATEST_LOGOUT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS LATEST_LOGOUT_DATE , LOGIN_FAIL_COUNT , LOGIN_BLOCK_YN , TO_CHAR(LOGIN_BLOCK_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS LOGIN_BLOCK_DATE , LOGIN_YN , SALT , DEL_YN FROM MEMBERS WHERE EMAIL = #{_parameter}
SELECT COUNT(EMAIL) FROM MEMBERS WHERE EMAIL = #{_parameter} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
SELECT COUNT(EMAIL) FROM MEMBERS WHERE NICKNAME = #{_parameter} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBERS (EMAIL , NAME , NICKNAME , PASSWORD , REGIST_DATE , SALT) VALUES (#{email} , #{name} , #{nickname} , #{password} , SYSDATE , #{salt})
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBERS SET LATEST_LOGIN_SUCCESS_DATE = SYSDATE , LOGIN_FAIL_COUNT = 0 , LOGIN_BLOCK_YN = 'N' , LOGIN_BLOCK_DATE = NULL , LOGIN_YN = 'Y' WHERE EMAIL = #{_parameter}
UPDATE MEMBERS SET LOGIN_FAIL_COUNT = LOGIN_FAIL_COUNT + 1 , LATEST_LOGIN_FAIL_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE EMAIL = #{_parameter}
UPDATE MEMBERS SET LOGIN_BLOCK_YN = 'Y' , LOGIN_BLOCK_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE EMAIL = #{_parameter} AND LOGIN_FAIL_COUNT >= 5
UPDATE MEMBERS SET LOGIN_BLOCK_YN = 'N' , LOGIN_BLOCK_DATE = NULL , LOGIN_FAIL_COUNT = 0 WHERE EMAIL = #{_parameter}
UPDATE MEMBERS SET LATEST_LOGOUT_DATE = SYSDATE , LOGIN_YN = 'N' WHERE EMAIL = #{_parameter}
UPDATE MEMBERS SET DEL_YN = 'Y' , PASSWORD = 'EXPIRED_USER' , SALT = 'EXPIRED_USER' WHERE EMAIL = #{_parameter}
